The real problem

Your jobs are not delayed because your team is lazy.

They are delayed because updates, approvals, site photos, staff follow-up and payment reminders are scattered across too many places.

1
Updates are buried in WhatsApp

Important progress messages disappear under daily chat noise.

2
Site photos are hard to find

Photos sit in someone’s phone gallery instead of the job timeline.

3
Approvals are unclear

Teams do not know which design, drawing or change request is final.

4
Clients keep asking for updates

Your team spends time forwarding the same progress information again and again.

5
Payment follow-up is manual

Advance, balance, pending and overdue payment status is checked separately.

6
Owners lack visibility

You only discover delays when the client complains or the deadline is already close.
